name: Blog Agent
description: Turns one keyword into a finished, publishable article that sounds like you.
scheduledTask: Pick one topic from the target keywords that has not been written yet. Outline it, then write the full article.
examples: Write an article about how to cut onboarding time
Outline a post for the keyword 'ai agent for founders'
Read my competitor's blog and tell me what they are missing

settings.label: Target keywords
settings.placeholder: ai marketing agent, replace saas tools, founder automation
settings.help: One per line or comma separated. The agent picks one per run.
